meta.title: Extend the live RFQ to 10 minutes after the current end
gaps: Verify the vendors' countdown shows the additional 10 minutes and that vendors can still bid until the new deadline.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the vendors' countdown shows the additional 10 minutes and that vendors can still bid until the new deadline.

steps.note: Open the existing prepared live RFQ on its project summary page.
Set the submission end to ten minutes after the current end and verify the extension is saved with the expected deadline change.
Open the event's Activity drawer to inspect the audit trail for the extension.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer opened.
Confirm the activity log contains the submission-time extension entry.
